review_description: I paid my deposit (half) for the work NEVER done. Fee brackets put on. Now the company is going under. Phone diverted, no emails back, no refund, excuse after excuse, complaint made to Fair Trade and seeking legal advice with advice from local companies, with a pile of messages and emails. Very disappointing

We've had problems with the system and services not installed as quoted or to the industry standard. Ended up having Energy Australia come to fix the system as the after sales service from uSwitch was dreadful. I sent many emails and phone calls with no reply. I suppose you get what you pay for with this company.
